Luka Dončić is on a HISTORIC tear! Luka put up 42 points, 13 assists, 7 rebounds, 6 three-pointers and 2 steals tonight, making it five straight games with 35+ points and back-to-back 40-point performances! He joins Damian Lillard as the only players in NBA history to record at least 35 points, 5 rebounds, 5 assists and 5 made threes in five consecutive games.
